## Description

Short description. 1-3 sentences max.

### Which issue does this PR tackle?

- XY functionality is not implemented.
- Fixes # (issue)

### How does it solve the problem?

- Implements XY function.

### How are the changes tested?

- Added test_xy.

## Checklist for Contributors

- [ ] Scope: This PR tackles exactly one problem.
- [ ] Target: The PR targets `develop`, or `main` if this is a hotfix.
- [ ] Size: The PR stays under about 400 changed lines.
- [ ] Conventions: The branch name follows the `feature/`, `bug/`, `chore/` or
      `hotfix/` plus title-slug convention.
- [ ] Conventions: The PR title follows the `Bugfix: Title (#42)` convention.
- [ ] Coding style: The code is formatted with Prettier.
- [ ] Documentation: All changes are well-documented.
- [ ] Tests: New features are tested and `node --test index.test.ts` passes.
- [ ] Review: A suitable reviewer has been assigned.

## Checklist for Reviewers

- [ ] The PR solves the issue it claims to solve and only this one.
- [ ] Changes are tested sufficiently and all tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation is complete and well-written.
